name: region
label: Region
help: The data residency region for your Amplitude project. Choose EU if your project uses Amplitude's EU data center, otherwise US.

name: apiKey
label: API Key
help: Your Amplitude project's API key. Find it at **Settings → Projects → [your project] → General**.

name: secretKey
label: Secret Key
help: Your Amplitude project's secret key, found alongside the API key at **Settings → Projects → [your project] → General**.
